video-indexer-retention-period.title: Set a retention period if you do not need to keep the original media
video-indexer-retention-period.body: Video Indexer keeps the original media in the connected storage account. Microsoft says to set the API retentionPeriod parameter between 1 and 7 if you do not need the originals, which limits storage cost that this estimate does not include.

citation.quote: If you don't need to keep the original media file in storage, set the API retentionPeriod parameter to a value between 1 and 7.

video-indexer-audio-and-video-billed.title: Audio and video analysis are charged separately
video-indexer-audio-and-video-billed.body: This estimate bills both an audio preset and a video preset for every minute. Microsoft says the indexing choice (video, audio or both) decides which SKUs are charged, so audio-only or video-only content costs less.

citation.quote: the user defines the indexing to be video analysis, audio analysis or both. The choice determines which SKUs get charged.
